atoms.exact_source_text: Citizens may possess additional fictional belongings that are not mechanically tracked.
atoms.normalized_claim: Citizens may possess additional fictional belongings that are not mechanically tracked.

atoms.exact_source_text: Cargo remains separate at party scale and is governed through Carry and Burden.
atoms.normalized_claim: Cargo remains separate at party scale and is governed through Carry and Burden.

atoms.exact_source_text: Tools grant permissions or narrow contextual effects.
atoms.normalized_claim: Tools grant permissions or narrow contextual effects.

atoms.exact_source_text: They do not provide generic stat inflation.
atoms.normalized_claim: Tools do not provide generic stat inflation.

atoms.exact_source_text: Citizens may change active items at Home, subject to availability and provenance.
atoms.normalized_claim: Citizens may change active items at Home, subject to availability and provenance.

atoms.exact_source_text: Guests use the same inventory architecture.
atoms.normalized_claim: Guests use the same inventory architecture as Citizens.

atoms.exact_source_text: Compatibility and manifestation handle morphology rather than creating separate Guest inventory systems.
atoms.normalized_claim: Compatibility and manifestation handle morphology rather than creating separate Guest inventory systems.

atoms.exact_source_text: **Adopted.**
atoms.normalized_claim: BSA-06A status is Adopted.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Colony prepares Supplies, deliberately makes Tools, and acquires Keepsakes through lived history.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Colony prepares Supplies, deliberately makes Tools, and acquires Keepsakes through lived history.

atoms.exact_source_text: These must not collapse into one generalized crafting-and-loot economy.
atoms.normalized_claim: Item source systems must not collapse into one generalized crafting-and-loot economy.

atoms.exact_source_text: Supplies are prepared through ordinary civic work.
atoms.normalized_claim: Supplies are prepared through ordinary civic work.

atoms.exact_source_text: They consume appropriate Sustenance and/or Scrap.
atoms.normalized_claim: Supplies consume appropriate Sustenance and/or Scrap.

atoms.exact_source_text: They are not produced from nothing.
atoms.normalized_claim: Supplies are not produced from nothing.

atoms.exact_source_text: Routine preparation is abstracted.
atoms.normalized_claim: Routine Supply preparation is abstracted.

atoms.exact_source_text: The player does not queue every pouch or bundle.
atoms.normalized_claim: The player does not queue every pouch or bundle of Supplies.

atoms.exact_source_text: Tools are not produced incidentally.
atoms.normalized_claim: Tools are not produced incidentally.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Tool is made deliberately through the Project Queue by a Crafter.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Tool is made deliberately through the Project Queue by a Crafter.

atoms.exact_source_text: Tool-making consumes Scrap, time, and Crafter Capacity.
atoms.normalized_claim: Tool-making consumes Scrap, time, and Crafter Capacity.

atoms.exact_source_text: Repair and adaptation may require tasked Crafting.
atoms.normalized_claim: Repair and adaptation of Tools may require tasked Crafting.

atoms.exact_source_text: Routine maintenance may remain abstracted.
atoms.normalized_claim: Routine Tool maintenance may remain abstracted.

atoms.exact_source_text: Tools and Supplies may occasionally be found through Node exploration or MEET.
atoms.normalized_claim: Tools and Supplies may occasionally be found through Node exploration or MEET.

atoms.exact_source_text: Found objects must be plausible in context.
atoms.normalized_claim: Found objects must be plausible in context.

atoms.exact_source_text: A recovered object may be immediately usable, returned as Cargo, repaired, adapted, or studied.
atoms.normalized_claim: A recovered object may be immediately usable, returned as Cargo, repaired, adapted, or studied.

atoms.exact_source_text: Tools should be rarer and more memorable than Supplies.
atoms.normalized_claim: Tools should be rarer and more memorable than Supplies.

atoms.exact_source_text: Supply finds may provide immediate relief or introduce a Supply form the Colony later learns to prepare.
atoms.normalized_claim: Supply finds may provide immediate relief or introduce a Supply form the Colony later learns to prepare.
